pagereader-button-label: Label on the read-aloud button before it starts speaking.
pagereader-button-label-stop: Label on the read-aloud button while it is speaking, to stop it.
pagereader-voice-label: Visually-hidden label for the voice-gender selector next to the read-aloud button.
pagereader-voice-auto: Option in the voice-gender selector: use the browser's default voice (ignores the site's configured gender preference, even if that is set to female or male). Labeled "browser dependent" since which voice this actually produces varies entirely by browser/OS, unlike the client-side Piper option. Used when $wgPageReaderAppearance is 'full' (the default); see pagereader-voice-auto-compact for 'compact'.
pagereader-voice-auto-compact: Shorter version of pagereader-voice-auto, used when $wgPageReaderAppearance is 'compact'. Drops the "(browser dependent)" qualifier to save space; the underlying behavior is identical either way.
pagereader-voice-female: Option in the voice-gender selector: prefer a voice labeled female. Labeled as a Chrome voice since Chrome is the browser most likely to have a real named female voice available; other browsers may fall back to the default voice regardless of this choice. Used when $wgPageReaderAppearance is 'full' (the default); see pagereader-voice-female-compact for 'compact'.
pagereader-voice-female-compact: Shorter version of pagereader-voice-female, used when $wgPageReaderAppearance is 'compact'. Drops the "(Chrome voice)" qualifier to save space; the underlying behavior is identical either way.
pagereader-voice-male: Option in the voice-gender selector: prefer a voice labeled male. Labeled as a Chrome voice since Chrome is the browser most likely to have a real named male voice available; other browsers may fall back to the default voice regardless of this choice. Used when $wgPageReaderAppearance is 'full' (the default); see pagereader-voice-male-compact for 'compact'.
pagereader-voice-male-compact: Shorter version of pagereader-voice-male, used when $wgPageReaderAppearance is 'compact'. Drops the "(Chrome voice)" qualifier to save space; the underlying behavior is identical either way.
pagereader-voice-piper: Option in the voice selector: switch to the higher-quality client-side Piper voice ("Amy"). Only shown on a WebAssembly/AudioContext-capable browser with the feature enabled. Used when $wgPageReaderAppearance is 'full' (the default); see pagereader-voice-piper-compact for 'compact'.
pagereader-voice-piper-compact: Shorter version of pagereader-voice-piper, used when $wgPageReaderAppearance is 'compact'. Drops the "(better voice)" qualifier to save space.
pagereader-pause-label: Label on the pause button while speech is in progress and not yet paused.
pagereader-pause-label-resume: Label on the pause button while speech is currently paused, to resume it.
pagereader-piper-loading: Label on the main read-aloud button between clicking it (while using the Piper engine) and the first sentence's audio actually starting. Amy's first synthesis on a page load has real WASM warm-up cost -- session init plus the first inference -- which can take several seconds on a slower device, with nothing else visibly happening in that window; without this label the button would misleadingly say "Stop reading" before any audio has actually started. Used when $wgPageReaderAppearance is 'full' (the default); see pagereader-piper-loading-compact for 'compact'.
pagereader-piper-loading-compact: Shorter version of pagereader-piper-loading, used when $wgPageReaderAppearance is 'compact'.
pagereader-piper-warning-text: Text shown in the inline warning box under the voice selector when the reader picks the Piper voice option but hasn't downloaded it yet. Explicitly says which voice the main read-aloud button will actually use in the meantime, since the select showing "Amy" otherwise makes it look like clicking read-aloud will already use her. Used when $wgPageReaderAppearance is 'full' (the default); see pagereader-piper-warning-text-compact for 'compact'. {{doc-important|Approximate size of the en_US-amy-medium Piper voice model in megabytes; update if the pinned voice/version changes.}}
pagereader-piper-warning-text-compact: Shorter version of pagereader-piper-warning-text, used when $wgPageReaderAppearance is 'compact'. Keeps the same two facts (approximate download size, and which voice Read uses in the meantime) in fewer words. {{doc-important|Approximate size of the en_US-amy-medium Piper voice model in megabytes; update if the pinned voice/version changes.}}
pagereader-piper-download-button: Label on the button inside the inline warning box that starts the Piper voice model download. Same in both 'full' and 'compact' appearance -- already short enough that a separate compact variant would not save meaningful space.
pagereader-piper-downloading: Text shown in the inline warning box while the voice model is downloading. Progress percentage is appended by JS, not part of this message. Used when $wgPageReaderAppearance is 'full' (the default); see pagereader-piper-downloading-compact for 'compact'.
pagereader-piper-downloading-compact: Shorter version of pagereader-piper-downloading, used when $wgPageReaderAppearance is 'compact'. Progress percentage is appended by JS, not part of this message.
